roles.analysis_role: Monocle3 lineage trajectories and modified covariate-aware gene testing
roles.usage_summary: Used Monocle3 1.0.0 on the reported UMAT embedding to reconstruct lineage trajectories and select shortest paths; a modified graph_test with covariates identified trajectory-associated genes.
roles.implementation_scope_note: The paper reports UMAT, not UMAP. Exact original Monocle3 package1.0.0 prepared-CDS graph/neighbor stages and explicit native weight, response/design preparation, ordering and residual-Moran primitives are now qualified in the source-built JAR. These require the complete caller-supplied population, coordinates/factors, roots, rankings/weights, size factors and numeric covariate coding. They do not reconstruct the author execution commit, UMAT/raw-count preparation, selected shortest paths, metadata coding, metacell smoothing, spline fitting or clustering. The privately inspected author fork was not run or redistributed. Its per-gene FAIL/OK-only BH behavior is distinct from native complete-family refusal for unresolved residuals or unsupported self-arcs. No stock unadjusted Moran or generic preprocessing is credited as the modified paper test.

roles.analysis_role: Separate py-monocle trajectory benchmark and Braak-selected roots
roles.usage_summary: Compared pseudotime from py-monocle, described in the paper as a Monocle 3 Python wrapper, with neural-network predictions and Palantir in microglia; tried 200 eligible starting cells and retained the highest Braak-stage correlation.
roles.implementation_scope_note: This paragraph uses the separate py-monocle Python implementation, although the paper calls it a Monocle3 wrapper. R/native Monocle controls do not qualify that provider, its exact paper commit or settings. The recorded intended use is educational/research/nonprofit; the earlier waiting-for-use-category note is stale. No py-monocle runtime or analysis is qualified here, and its separate missing row is unchanged. Preserve the microglia population, donor-root eligibility,200 trials and retention of the highest Braak correlation. That selected correlation is not independent predictive validation.

roles.analysis_role: Cicero co-accessibility with Monocle3 platform context
roles.usage_summary: Used Cicero for Monocle 3 to infer cis-co-accessible cCRE pairs per cell subclass, using mm10, default Cicero parameters and 500 kb genomic windows.
roles.implementation_scope_note: The paragraph establishes Cicero for Monocle3 co-accessibility, not a Monocle trajectory run. Cicero already has its own scoped original co-accessibility and supplied-prediction workflows; this admission adds no Cicero or trajectory credit for this context. Exact paper patches, shuffled-background fitting, filtering direction, FDR threshold, TSS annotation and distal/proximal population choices remain distinct. Preserve the reported failed Hypendymal_NN subclass and the literal filtering wording; do not reverse its meaning.

roles.analysis_role: Monocle3 and Batchelor integration followed by pseudotime
roles.usage_summary: Applied the Monocle3 pipeline with Batchelor 1.20.0 integration, Monocle3 1.3.7 dimensional reduction/clustering and pseudotime; a separate Wilcoxon test compared immature control and Tgfbr2-mutant cells.
roles.implementation_scope_note: The paragraph explicitly reports Monocle3 1.3.7 and Batchelor1.20.0. The source-built ALIGN-1.3.7 action now executes the original selected1.3.7/1.20 prepared pipeline with complete saved models and native graph audits; these are no longer source-only candidates. Exact paper preprocessing, integration/reduction/clustering/graph settings, roots and transformations remain unstated and are not inferred. Batchelor already has separate scoped credit covering P040/P051; no extra Batchelor/helper credit is added. The separate reported Wilcoxon test used continuity correction and is not a Monocle model.

roles.analysis_role: Monocle3 spatial-expression gene GLMs with amyloid covariates
roles.usage_summary: Used monocle3 1.3.1 fit_models GLMs to relate spatial gene expression to amyloid Getis-Ord Gi* hotspot scores, adjusting for biological sample and UMI count; followed significant Wald-test results with positive Pearson-correlation filtering.
roles.implementation_scope_note: This is gene-wise GLM inference, not pseudotime. Original1.3.1 prepared fit_models/coefficient workflows and optional native Pearson filtering are qualified; the old grr/R4.6.1 skip is historical. Complete caller-specified units, family, numeric/factor coding and testing population remain required. Original quasi-Poisson/t-coefficient and grouped-Holm behavior is preserved; paper Wald/FDR wording and documentation BH wording do not establish an unreported override. Human grey-matter filtering, mouse regional fits, separate stains and positive Pearson selection remain explicit separate population/selection steps. The exact author formula, normalization and executed commit are not recovered.

roles.analysis_role: Monocle2 differential gene, exon and accessibility testing
roles.usage_summary: Used Monocle 2 differentialGeneTest for gene/exon and accessibility comparisons, age/AD analyses with sex covariates, subtype fraction likelihood-ratio tests, and human AD/control expression comparisons; populations and significance/effect/expression filters differ by analysis.
roles.implementation_scope_note: The source-built typed original Monocle2 2.26.0 adapter preserves complete differential-test populations, size factors, dispersions and native BH audits. The paper reports Monocle2 without an exact patch;2.26.0 is a selected qualified edition, not a recovered paper patch. Supporting Methods retain distinct subcluster/exon/accessibility/human populations, maximum5000 sampling, sex covariates and RT-well/mouse replicate definitions. Exact family, full formulas and normalization remain unresolved. TPM thresholds do not establish raw-count eligibility; cells are not mouse replicates. Retained original free-NB/binomial failures remain unadmitted; do not drop failed genes, replace failures with p/q=1 or substitute Monocle3 tests.

roles.analysis_role: Monocle3 prepared-embedding graph learning and rooted ordering
roles.usage_summary: Constructed trajectories on selected transition regions with monocle3 1.3.3 learn_graph, varying ncenter across 130/140/150 and minimal_branch_len across 15/20, with close_loop=FALSE; ordered from a terminal node in the assumed transition direction.
roles.implementation_scope_note: Original Monocle3 1.3.3 graph learning and optional rooted ordering are qualified for complete caller-prepared UMAP/cluster/partition populations, including all six ncenter130/140/150 by minimal_branch_len15/20 combinations with close_loop=FALSE. These are no longer source-only candidates. Exact selected cells/embedding, mapping of controls to transitions, executed commit and root identifiers remain unstated. The paper uses an assumed transition direction; synthetic roots and native supplied-graph ordering do not recover its biological direction. Never substitute1.4.27 or infer a root.

roles.analysis_role: Protein-activity pseudotrajectory in malignant pancreatic cells
roles.usage_summary: Inferred Monocle pseudotrajectories from metaVIPER protein-activity profiles of 1,856 malignant pancreatic cells, alongside separate Seurat/Louvain state clustering.
roles.implementation_scope_note: The inputs are metaVIPER protein-activity profiles for1856 malignant cells, not raw RNA counts. Monocle generation/patch, family, graph options and roots are unstated, so no specific original edition or count workflow is credited as paper-equivalent. Only explicitly caller-prepared graph ordering or explicitly declared finite-response arithmetic is available as a general component. Do not infer a log/size-factor transform or count-model eligibility. metaVIPER/ARACNe inference, clustering, cross-cohort enrichment and biological state interpretation remain separate.
